audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits: Mortal Steel is a free 4s cycle that knocks up at 2 stacks, Spirit Cleave shields every 14s, and Soul Unbound lets him open a trade with no body to punish.
audit.corrected: Rating kept; the difficulty is now expressed as those three timers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Yone/Yone/Skill/Skill/Yone/Skill/Yone while content win[] and the packet chart agree on Diana/Diana/Yone/Diana/Diana/Yone/Diana.
audit.why: Content and packet match exactly, so full was stale. Level 3 is genuinely his (Soul Unbound plus the Mortal Steel knock-up before your reset exists) and first item is his (crit spike while Moonfall sits on 100s).
audit.corrected: All seven sides aligned to win[]; phases[2].why and phases[5].why rewritten to describe Yone winning those rows in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page stated what Soul Unbound actually does — the spirit snapping back to the body and repeating a portion of its damage — nor that Spirit Cleave's shield grows with champions hit.
audit.why: Riot's text: the spirit is forced back to the body and repeats a portion of the damage dealt; Spirit Cleave's shield value is increased by the number of champions hit.
audit.corrected: Both stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[2] and enemyWin.

audit.why: Soul Unbound halves from 22s to 10s across its ranks — that is the whole shape of the lane.
audit.corrected: Soul Unbound 22s/10s, Spirit Cleave 14s, Mortal Steel 4s, Fate Sealed 120s/80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED); dosFull[0]/[2] and dontsFull[0] were filler under specific titles.
audit.why: Bodies must explain the title above them.
audit.corrected: Replaced with kit-grounded bodies carrying real numbers.

edits.before: E pull joins... no — your dash threat begins: Q-mark into E reset chases are live; trade on every landed crescent.
edits.after: Level 3 he has Soul Unbound plus the Mortal Steel knock-up — his dash-in punishes you before your reset exists.

edits.before: First item spike: the mark-dash combo chunks half bars and the reset chains through waves.
edits.after: His first crit item wins the all-in whenever Moonfall sits on its 100s rank-1 cooldown.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Pale Cascade like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound: 22s at rank 1, 10s at rank 5 — his spirit snaps back to the body and repeats its damage, so fight where the body is. - Spirit Cleave shields every 14s and Mortal Steel cycles at 4s; Fate Sealed is 120s at rank 1, 80s at rank 3.

edits.before: His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Your passive cleaves on the third strike — land it, then leave before Spirit Cleave shields him in 14s.

edits.before: Q through the wave onto his chest, E the mark, three-hit string, walk — the phase trade he answers after you've left.
edits.after: Pale Cascade shields on cast — hold the orbs for the moment his spirit snaps back, not for the walk into his cone.

edits.before: Yone whiffs Soul Unbound and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Fate Sealed is 120s at rank 1 — once it is gone, Moonfall him.

edits.before: That is Yone’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Mortal Steel costs no mana at 4s — the long fight is his.

edits.before: Dashing onto an unmarked target with W down — Diana without the reset or the shield is a melee mage donating proximity.
edits.after: Mortal Steel dashes him through the wave at 4s and Spirit Cleave shields off every champion it hits — his wave, his fight.

edits.before: Yone wins by landing Soul Unbound, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Yone wins by opening in spirit form, snapping back onto you for repeat damage, and knocking you up with Mortal Steel.

edits.before: Carry through the dive — mark, dash, pull, delete; your R turns their teamfight spacing into a suggestion.
edits.after: Fate Sealed pulls your whole line in — Moonfall answers the same clump, so hold R until his blink is spent.

notes: Content whys[] here are written in third person about Diana ('Diana's early Q poke') rather than the site's second-person voice used everywhere else on the page. Left alone — it is a whole-array voice question, not a fact error, and rewriting seven entries was outside the sweep. Full-layer sides were stale on all seven rows against a content chart that already matched the packet; rows 2 and 5 moved to Yone with both whys rewritten. tradeGood/tradeBad left generic — nothing further in Yone's kit to ground them without inventing.
